seo.title: AI agents for business | Humanika
seo.description: AI digital collaborators for business: training, knowledge, service, sales and operations, connected to your systems and with human review.

hero.title: Digital collaborators that work alongside your teams
hero.description: Humanika designs AI agents that train, answer, sell and operate with your company's knowledge and systems. You set the rules; the agent applies them and hands the case to a person when needed.

areas.title: A digital collaborator for every area
areas.description: Start with the process that matters most and expand to other areas on the same platform.

items.title: Training
items.text: Tutors available whenever people need them: onboarding, ongoing training and progress tracking.

items.title: Knowledge
items.text: Your company documentation, searchable in plain language and with references to the source.

items.title: Service and support
items.text: Service over WhatsApp, web chat and voice, with escalation to your team when a case needs it.

items.title: Sales
items.text: Support for every sales opportunity, with information recorded in your CRM, such as HubSpot.

items.title: Operations
items.text: Automation of repetitive tasks with configurable workflows and a record of every step.

items.title: Marketing performance
items.text: Review of Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, with findings and recommendations for your team.

connections.title: Connected to your team's tools
connections.description: Available integrations are confirmed for each project.

cta.title: Try a digital collaborator with a case from your company
cta.description: Tell us which process you want to improve and we'll show you how it would work with your information and channels.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to request a Humanika demo for my company.
